module: Generated file (about 2200 lines, ~485 functions) that exposes almost the entire Dear ImGui API in Lua as very thin wrappers over Engine.imgui (the game's C++ binding): NewFrame/Render, windows, widgets (Text, Button, Slider*, Drag*, Input*, Combo, Tree*, Table*, Plot*), ImDrawList_*, styles (PushStyleColor*, PushStyleVar*), IO, fonts, and the enums as constants M.Xxx_Yyy (e.g. WindowFlags_NoTitleBar, Col_Text, Key_*). It is not an extension: it returns a function that receives the table M of imgui_api. The numeric suffixes (Button/SmallButton, TreeNode1/TreeNode2, Combo1, PushStyleColor2...) correspond to the C++ overloads of the same function.
usage:
-- Used via ui_imgui:
local im = ui_imgui
if im.Begin('Test') then
  if im.Button('OK') then print('click') end
end
im.End()
notes: File convention: each wrapper checks the parameters of type 'const char *'; if nil, it logs an error ("Parameter 'x' of function 'F' cannot be nil, as the c type is 'const char *'") and returns without calling ImGui.
The "pointer" parameters (bool_p_open, float*, int*...) are tables {[0]=value} created by BoolPtr/FloatPtr/IntPtr/ArrayChar (see imgui_custom_luaintf).
Default values are set in the wrappers (e.g. flags = 0 if nil).
Several functions in this file are rewritten by imgui_custom_luaintf.lua (Begin, InputText, GetKeyIndex...): the custom version wins since it is loaded afterwards.
The functions of this file are not listed one by one here: they follow the official Dear ImGui documentation (the name suffix indicates the overload).

NewFrame.desc: Starts a new ImGui frame (normally handled by the engine).

EndFrame.desc: Ends the ImGui frame (handled by the engine).

Render.desc: Finalizes the ImGui rendering (handled by the engine).

ShowDebugLogWindow.desc: Shows the ImGui debug log window.

ShowStackToolWindow.desc: Shows the ImGui ID stack tool.

Begin.desc: Opens a window (flags 0 by default in this version; the custom version sets NoFocusOnAppearing).

returns.desc: True if the window is visible.

GetKeyIndex.desc: Converts a key to an index (imgui.GetKeyIndex); replaced by a no-op version in imgui_custom_luaintf.
